helpBid: bid raise|pass            raise the bid by 10 or pass
helpDiscard: d <idx>                   give a card to an opponent (talon exchange)
promptBidHelp: bid raise ... raise by 10  |  bid pass ... drop out of the auction
promptTalonHelp: d <idx> ... give a card to each opponent (one to each, twice)
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (A>10>K>Q>J>9; must follow suit, then must trump if void)
promptMarriageHelp: Marriage: leading the K or Q of a same-suit K+Q sets that suit as trump and scores ♠40/♣60/♦80/♥100
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... go to the next trick
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... go to the next round
hintReasonLeadLow: Lead a low card to conserve points
hintReasonLeadMarriage: Lead the King to declare a marriage and set trump
hintReasonFollowWin: Points on the table — win the trick
hintReasonDiscardLow: Cannot follow suit — discard a low card
helpExampleBid: bid pass                  drop out of the bidding
helpExampleNext: n                         read the trick result, then continue
